_readme: Human-maintained sidecar for ee/docs/claim-traceability.md. This file is the ONLY
place the Applications table and the Verified column are edited; the markdown page
is generated, and a hand edit to it is caught by
`scripts/ci/extract-claim-traceability.py --check` (make claim-traceability-check).
applications: one entry per filed application, keyed by the family label used in
ee/ claim citations. Every family cited anywhere in ee/ source MUST appear here
or the generator refuses to run, so a new family cannot quietly ship without its
filing data. Fields, all strings:
subject         short title of the application as filed.
application_no  the USPTO application serial. Leave empty until counsel
confirms it is publishable in an open repository.
filed           YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is being recorded.
converted_by    normally left empty: the generator computes filing + 12 months,
the deadline to convert a US provisional to a non-provisional,
at the same precision the filing date was given. Set it
explicitly only to record a date counsel has fixed otherwise.
An empty string renders as an explicit pending marker in the table, so an unfilled field is
visible rather than silently blank.
verified: sparse map of "FAMILY-CLAIM" to counsel's verification note, e.g.
"AGID-3": "reviewed 2026-09-14, practises as claimed". Any claim absent from the
map renders as _[counsel]_, meaning no review has been recorded yet.
certctl LLC holds four US provisional applications, filed July 2026. Nothing has
issued, so the marking stays "patent pending" (guarded by docs/patent_marking_test.go).
